definitions.gloss: gradually; little by little; step by step
definitions.explanation: Happening slowly over time; progressing in small increments.

examples.japanese: {次第|しだい}に⟦{慣|な}れてきた→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧。
examples.english: I gradually got used to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{次第|しだい}に⟦{暗|くら}くなった→暗い：00647_kurai⟧。
{次第|しだい}に⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{次第|しだい}に means "gradually" or "progressively," describing change that occurs slowly over time.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧: gradually (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}に→徐々に：04131_jojoni⟧: gradually (formal, written)
- ⟦{少|すこ}しずつ→少しずつ：20047_sukoshizutsu⟧: little by little (emphasis on small increments)
- ⟦{段階的|だんかいてき}に→段階的：06174_dankaiteki⟧: step by step, in stages

NUANCE DIFFERENCES:
- {次第|しだい}に: neutral to formal; emphasizes continuous progression
- ⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧: casual; most common in spoken Japanese
- ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}に→徐々に：04131_jojoni⟧: formal/literary; often in written contexts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {次第|しだい}に⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: to gradually get used to
- {次第|しだい}に⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: to gradually increase
- {次第|しだい}に⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to gradually change
- {次第|しだい}に⟦{分|わ}かってくる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to gradually come to understand

REGISTER:
More formal than ⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧, appropriate for both spoken and written Japanese.
